patch_resolves_note: The staged fix changes the fuzz-only span setup from `len` to `len - 1`; the fixed original still reaches `multiline_probe`, but does so with `lexer_end` one byte before `(char *)data + len`, so the parser exits cleanly before the out-of-bounds re-entry.

nodes.description: At the `strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)` sink, the first probe argument is already equal to `lexer->end`, so the sink is probing from the exclusive end of the parser span.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable frozen trace shows `multiline_probe.strncmp_pos == multiline_probe.lexer_end == 0x114d4a0` at the crashing probe.

edges.description: The exclusive parser bound materialized for the fuzzing span is carried unchanged into the later multiline-string probe as `lexer->end`.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable frozen trace shows `fuzz_span_ready.lexer_end == multiline_probe.lexer_end == 0x114d4a0`; fixed original likewise preserves the bound (`0x114d49f`).

edges.description: The cursor value written back to `lexer->pos` by `next(lexer)` in the loop condition is the same pointer used as the first `strncmp` argument on the following multiline-string probe.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable frozen trace shows `loop_condition_advance.pos_after_next == multiline_probe.strncmp_pos == 0x114d4a0`; fixed original shows the same carry at the safe boundary (`0x114d49f`).

root_cause_criterion.description: After `config_open_for_fuzzing()` materializes the lexer span for the copied fuzz buffer, `config->parser.lexer.end` must remain strictly below `(char *)data + len`, reserving one trailing byte outside the logical parser extent so `next()` can terminate before a later multiline-string probe re-enters on the first byte past the span.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable original trace the protected `multiline_probe` event executes with `fuzz_span_ready.lexer_end == fuzz_span_ready.data_limit == 0x114d4a0`, so the required predicate is violated. In the fixed original trace `multiline_probe` still executes genuinely while `fuzz_span_ready.lexer_end == 0x114d49f < 0x114d4a0 == fuzz_span_ready.data_limit`.
